{{Quote|We're going to start with Zolo Sartain, the chief tactician for the Maulers.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TSE" />}}
'''Zolo Sartain''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TSE" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> he was the chief tactician of the [[Maulers]], a criminal group that operated on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Sartain was killed during a [[Royal Marine Regiment]] [[Royal Security Forces marines raid on Mauler base|operation]] in the [[Mauler Stronghold]].<ref name="SWG:TSE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zolo Sartain appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:TSE" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Zolo Sartain was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
